chunks: And with his chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

The Imams are from the progeny of Al-Husayn. Whoever obeys them has obeyed Allah, and whoever disobeys them has disobeyed Allah, the Mighty and Exalted. They are the Reliable Grip, and they are the Means to Allah, the Mighty and Exalted.
ai.seo_question: Who are the Imams and what is their relationship to God according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq, underscores the theological necessity of following the Ahl al-Bayt by linking their obedience directly to divine obedience, a concept central to Shia Usul al-Din. It elevates the Imams as the 'Urwah al-Wuthqa' (Reliable Grip) and Wasilah, echoing Quranic verses that highlight their role as the exclusive means of drawing near to God, thereby affirming their infallibility and authority as the continuation of prophetic guidance.
